task: What is reranking according to my notes?
ground_truth: A cross-encoder re-scores the top-N retrieved candidates by jointly encoding (query, chunk). It is slower per pair than bi-encoders so it is applied only to a shortlist; first-stage vector retrieval optimizes recall while reranking fixes ordering.

task: List the chunking strategies from my vault.
ground_truth: There are three chunking strategies: fixed-size with overlap (around 512 tokens with 10-15% overlap), recursive or structural (split on headings, then paragraphs, then sentences), and semantic (break where embedding similarity drops).
